title: Assistant Professor in Finance - Toulouse Campus
text:
CANDIDATE PROFILE 
PhD completed or near completion in Finance, or in related fields with a Finance research focus, from an internationally recognised institution
Potential and ability to publish in leading peer-reviewed journals (AJG | FNEGE)
Ability to teach effectively in English (ability to teach in French would be an asset) at both undergraduate and graduate levels
Commitment to pedagogical excellence and innovation
Interest to develop interdisciplinary teaching & research activities (sustainability, AI & data…)
Collaborative and collegial mindset, good communication skills and willingness to contribute to institutional life activities and development
Post-doctoral experience considered a plus
Teaching needs include Sustainable Finance. The candidate’s expertise in these areas will be a plus
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
Research: Develop an active research agenda, publish internationally, foster academic collaborations, and disseminate research findings
Teaching: Deliver high-quality teaching and develop pedagogical materials across different academic programs and levels of study
Service: Contribute actively to initiatives within the department, the research lab, and Centre(s) of Excellence
WHAT WE OFFER 
International environment
Teaching loads consistent with research ambitions
Dedicated research support & resources
Support from a specialised pedagogical innovation team
Attractive employment conditions and comprehensive benefits
Relocation assistance and French language support
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT AND THE RESEARCH LABORATORY
Faculty members of the Department of Economics and Finance and the Research Lab Finance Economics and Econometrics share a common ambition: to produce rigorous and impactful research, deliver high-quality teaching, and provide outstanding student experience. They value methodological diversity, intellectual openness and interdisciplinary dialogue. The Department and the Research Lab provide an environment where faculty are encouraged to develop ambitious research agendas and create impact beyond academia.
Our faculty members publish regularly in Journal of Corporate Finance, Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, Management Science, Review of Financial Studies...
More information: ECOFI Department | FEE Lab
ABOUT TBS EDUCATION
Founded in 1903, TBS Education is a leading Triple Crown accredited business school. Academic excellence, impactful research, pedagogical innovation and societal engagement are at the heart of its strategy. More than 120 nationalities and 6,000 students are present on its 4 campuses located in the heart of dynamic cities: Toulouse, Paris, Barcelona (Spain) and Casablanca (Morocco). Teaching and Research at TBS Education are articulated around six departments, six Research Labs, three Centers of Excellence. Faculty are encouraged to combine scientific rigour with practical relevance and to contribute to a more responsible, sustainable and inclusive economy. TBS Education is also highly committed to Pedagogical Innovation.
More information: About TBS Education | TBS Education Business for Good | High Impact Research TBS Education | Pedagogical Innovation
APPLICATION PROCEDURE
Candidates are invited to fill out the application form on TBS Education’s recruitment page by Monday, January 4, 2027: Faculty Application TBS Education
The complete application package should be submitted in English and should include:
A cover letter
A complete Curriculum Vitae with a list of publications and courses taught (list of courses, level of programmes, number of hours, and language of instruction)
Samples of research (published or working papers)
A teaching statement and teaching evaluations
The names of 3 referees who can be contacted
>> Practical questions or issues concerning the application: faculty.jobs@tbs-education.fr
>> Clarification questions can be directed to the Head of Department: Gilles LAFFORGUE g.lafforgue@tbs-education.fr
Exceptional candidates at the rank of Associate Professor can be considered but must contact the Head of Department before applying.
Interviews with shortlisted candidates will take place on Wednesday 10 March 2027.
In line with the values promoted by TBS Education, we are committed to professional equality and the employment of disabled workers. As part of our recruitment process, all applications are examined.
